SayText1: Weapons, Armours, we offer it all!
SayText0: I sell the finest in weapons and armors!
SayText4: Good folk, I mean.
SayText2: My weapons will assuredly slay thine enemies!
JoinText: Welcome, we offer the finest in weapons and armour.  I'm working 'round the clock now, we must prepare for the honorable King Dekkar III has declared it! Always trusted them Dekkars', gold folk I tell you.
SayText3: Nothing is finer than a Garad crafted Stabbin' Dagger!
LeaveText: Bye, good luck on your travels.  Get your weapons while you can!
Name: Garad

SayText1: Don't trust potions you find lying around, could be toxic.
SayText0: Potions are good business if you know what your doing.
SayText4: You can't tell the difference between good and bad potions.
SayText2: My healing potions are guaranteed.
JoinText: Welcome to my lab of alchemy, young one.
SayText3: I also buy toxic healing potions if you find some.
LeaveText: Good bye, come again.
Name: Granny Korgins

SayText1: Them guilds is always fighting, not like the glory days of King Dekkar I
SayText0: Business is good these days, what with the shadow wars.
SayText2: The rifts between worlds increasin'. Lots of strange demons n stuff poppin in.
JoinText: Something big and bad's gonna happen soon. I can feel it.  I've been feeling it for the past 7 years now..I sure love fish, don't you? All fish restaurant's comin next!
SayText3: Something big and bad's gonna happen soon. I can feel it.
LeaveText: ..you all thought I was crazy...but now..now you'll see...NOW you listen to the Oracle..never listen to me..never...*mumbles*
Name: The Barkeep

SayText1: I'll buy boats back that you find.
SayText4: Rowboats are only useful in some areas.
SayText2: I sell the most finest boats in the land!
JoinText: Welcome to my humble boat store.  I am not worried at all.  King Dekkar III will protect us from anything.  The Dekkars always have.
LeaveText: Come again soon
Name: Erlington

SayText1: Ya hear they be buildin' up a new town to the south? Aye...Riverdale tis its name
SayText0: Ar, lads. The seas be fine today.
SayText4: Arr, I be hating them elves in the forest.
SayText2: I used ta be an adventurer o' da high seas until they took me hand!
JoinText: Arr, welcome to me cap'ns table
SayText3: Ye hear that an old pyramid got uncovered in the Draconis Wastes, aye?
LeaveText: Ye be comin' back soon, aye?
Name: Cap'n Cook

SayText1: Leather armor's more popular in peace time. Not with these shadow wars..
SayText0: Not much demand for leather these days.
SayText4: Come to think of it, I should just get rid of my last leather good and be a sole lumber merchant.
SayText2: Our leather is made from troll skin. Cows are rare in these parts.
JoinText: Welcome to me shop, I sell wooden and leather goods.  With a supply of Lumber, I can make an assortment of items, including Paper!
SayText3: The trees around here are magical, and never fully get chopped down no matter how much wood you cut from 'em! They say it has something to do with that crazy Horticulturist.
LeaveText: Hope ta see ye again.  Bring me more lumber!
Name: Madargan Gar

SayText1: Volume, volume, volume. And even then I don't make much.
SayText0: The Tools o' Trade, yet sometimes The Tools o' Scamming!
SayText4: My business is profusely underused.
SayText2: I should just sell this stuff instead.
JoinText: Care to trade adventurer?
SayText3: Who would trade Scorpion stingers for an Old Raft anyways?
LeaveText: See ya next time.
Name: Trader Jim

SayText1: I proposed to my wife with a Sapphire ring. She was unimpressed to say the least.
SayText0: We can exchange goods for quick cash.
SayText4: We buy gems here.
SayText2: We sell gems here.
JoinText: Welcome, my friend, to the Crendale Bank.  Type /bank to deposit and withdraw your gold and items.  I never believed the barkeep before...fools we were! Now its too late! AH
SayText3: We buy gems here.
LeaveText: Please Come again.  Store your valuables here! Our vault is barricaded finer than any in the kingdom.  Whatever comes, they'll be safe, even if you're not!
Name: Banker Tyler

SayText1: I love the smell of the sea breeze.
SayText0: Having a nice day, aren't we?
SayText4: I made my dog a little house from coolie hats.
SayText2: I'll buy back wolf and other exotic pelts
JoinText: Welcome to my store, I sell furs and clothing.
SayText3: Come to think of it, I don't know ANY horticulturists...
LeaveText: Good bye, come again...
Name: Tailor Taylor

SayText1: Hates me those trolls...greasy, barbaric fellows. Here they got scouts in these parts.
SayText0: The trolls are moving in an army, that's apparent enough. Damn scouts everywhere.
SayText4: Dragonia's the capitol. Bah, King Dekkar III is a fool.
SayText2: Forests full of bandits these days. Not safe for anyone anywhere.
JoinText: Hey there, yun' un, whatcha doin' here? Since you ar' here though, I am in dire need of an outsiders aid.  Ya' see, my daughters very sick with Suoitanes, but I am far too old to get any Aitercul root myself...I would be very greatful if you could help.
SayText3: Got any wine?  Buy it off ya
LeaveText: Ok, good bye and good luck! If that old witch Hilda is still alive, she may have some Aitercul root laying around somewhere..
Name: The Hermit

SayText1: Beware the power of the elvish blade
SayText0: The elves are migrating to your lands. We shall soon overrun them if you are not careful.
SayText2: Only Kair-Norax could stop us.
JoinText: What are you doing here? Oh if I only had some cake! or something better....mmmmm....
SayText3: You may think our village small, but it will soon blossom across this entire island.
LeaveText: Good riddance
Name: Chief Syltanath

SayText1: Most of the elves do not like the humans.
SayText0: I do not mind where the gold comes from as long as I receive some.
SayText4: You know who we REALLY hate though? Dwarves.
SayText2: We need weapons and armor.
JoinText: Hmm...I suppose I can sell to you, even though you are not one of us.
SayText3: Sell me your chainmail, we can use it.
LeaveText: Be wary, stranger
Name: Elvish Merchant

SayText1: I will buy old armor and weapons off you
SayText0: I buy shields, and many other things
SayText4: Just raised the selling price of plate!
SayText2: I buy only the finest weapons
JoinText: Ah welcome, I buy and sell armor.
LeaveText: Goodbye, come again, friend.
Name: Borrigarn

SayText1: I lent my brother my copy of the Da'Vinci Code. If you see him, could you ask for it back?
SayText0: If you ever meet my brother Varakarad, be sure to say hi.
SayText4: I wonder where that chimney goes up to.
SayText2: Gardening is one of my favorite hobbies, when I'm not being attacked by graverobbers.
JoinText: Congratulations!  Would you care for a cup of tea?  Or perhaps some caviar.  or perhaps some ink? I just really need a candle, it's so dark in here!
SayText3: Different demons prefer different atmospheres. I like living among the dead, my brother likes the ice, and my cousin, the Elder of Flames, prefers, well, you can imagine.
LeaveText: Excuse me for my form, but that damn V'drazzig caused this and he's hiding in that tower at the east coast, if he was here! I would crush him into bits!
Name: Golgatha

SayText1: YOU'D be angry too if your testicles froze off.
SayText0: Bragahh grahh raahhh!
SayText2: You look perplexed; all yetis can talk, but we'd rather just kill you instead.
JoinText: Flaming scoundrels! I'll have your heart someday...on a platter! Ventures into the warmest place in the land...molten earth hell!
LeaveText: It's getting warmer and warmer around these parts.....
Name: Angry Yeti

SayText1: I specialize in maces.
SayText0: Do my wares please you?
SayText2: I'll buy all sorts of swords from you.
JoinText: Welcome to my shop of arms.
SayText3: I melt down the swords I buy and smith them into sturdy maces.
LeaveText: May your weapons strike well.
Name: Jacobson

SayText1: I hear there are special mineral veins around the world, so I was searching for them, and then fell down here.
SayText0: I knew I should have just stayed in the Crendale mines.
SayText2: I saw some creepy knights to the north, need to get out of here..
JoinText: I seem to have taken the wrong trail.  Can you point me in the direction towards the mountain? This sledge hammers getting heavy....I need some damned cigarettes..fresh out...fates not goin' my way...
LeaveText: Fine! Just like that time I fell down a hole and nobody would help me out...inconsiderate #@$@#$...
Name: Lost Miner

SayText1: I will buy your old shields.
SayText0: I sell shields and only shields.
SayText4: Never go into battle without a sturdy shield.
SayText2: Shields keep us all safe.
JoinText: Welcome to Shelly's House of Shields. I'm Shelly.
SayText3: I like safety. That's why I live in Dragonia. It's a safe town.
LeaveText: Keep safe.
Name: Shelly

SayText1: Some trolls want to hurt this land. Come through gate. Readying army. Not me.
SayText0: I am far from me homes. Me homes across the magic gate. Troll land.
SayText4: The troll army plan to invade soon. They will kill me as a traitor. :(
SayText2: I live here now. Sell weapons. Buy weapons. Far from troll home.
JoinText: Hm...Hi.
SayText3: Not many places troll can show face here.
LeaveText: Hm...bye
Name: Trankor

SayText1: You look like a dangerous sort, don't start any trouble here, ok?
SayText0: King Dekkar III is concerned about the large number of orcs and trolls in the woods.
SayText2: The King is losing control over the guilds.
JoinText: Aye, welcome to Draconis Tavern.
SayText3: That bard is really starting to get on my nerves...
LeaveText: Hope you come back.
Name: The Tavernkeep

SayText1: Can't teach ya magic, nope, sorry.
SayText0: I'll buy scorpion stings fer me magic.
SayText4: I always need me more of dem snake skins!
SayText2: Some spells aren't in the game yet, hehe.
JoinText: Ah, welcome welcome. Be ye lookin' fer magicks?
SayText3: Raised the price of the boots, they're damn popular!
LeaveText: Well, good luck on whatever it is you do.
Name: The Old Wizard

SayText1: I've lost my way....
SayText0: Hellpp meeee!
Name: Lost Miner

SayText1: I'm always on the move...
SayText0: Viruses...always gettin' blamed for viruses...
SayText4: Gosh! I sure am hungry!
SayText2: I buy used junk.
JoinText: Huhhuh...Welcome ta muh House o Garbage
SayText3: I always have the best solutions for your useless junk!
LeaveText: Yup. Lots o repeat business here.
Name: Robert Brodsty

SayText1: The elves think they can move into our lands. I call to brave warriors to help dissuade them.
SayText0: These are troubled times. Gateways to other worlds are opening...trolls, orcs...and darker things are coming through.
SayText4: The worst of it are the guild wars...our own kingdom crumbles from within.
SayText2: No one knows where the demons come from...barquests, elder nightmares and worse...they come from the gates beyond.
JoinText: Welcome to my castle, adventurer.  I seem to have misplaced my boots.
SayText3: Though the seven shepherds are now gone, there are those who still pray to the dark lord Kair-Norax. They are lost to us.
LeaveText: Help keep the lands safe, warrior.  I'm sure those old men in Babylon would have good use for a Cane.
Name: King Dekkar III

SayText1: Can't ever have too good of a helmet!
SayText0: The secret to helms is volume, volume, volume!
SayText4: Some people say I've already lost my head! Haha!
JoinText: Welcome to my store, I sell, buy and trade helms!
SayText3: You lose your head...you lose your life!
LeaveText: Goodbye, come again.
Name: Heinrich

SayText1: I'm a diamond kind of guy!
SayText0: Good credit, bad credit...you get no credit here!
SayText2: I'm a Credit Man! Too bad you're not getting any here
JoinText: Welcome to Pol's Ruby Center, bank of Dragonia.
LeaveText: Come back soon!
Name: Pol

SayText1: Once I followed the Shepherd Allistar, but I was seduced by the power of Kair-Norax.
SayText0: I am cursed to forever haunt these walls for my greed.
SayText4: I am cursed to forever haunt these walls for my greed.
SayText2: The Shepherds may be dead, but their power lives on!
JoinText: You have solved my pyramid. Type /buy to receive your reward.
SayText3: I was cursed by the same powers that I used to destroy others in life.
LeaveText: The Firerune creates a copy of the two swords I used in life!
Name: The Dead King

SayText1: I heard some guys saying there were better ninjas. F*ing unbelievable!
SayText0: I can't take damage...cuz I'm a ninja!
SayText4: I always save vrs. attacks. That's the way of the ninja!
SayText2: True ninjas can't be defeated.
JoinText: You are in THE best store in all of Dragonia.
SayText3: I also like warhammers.
LeaveText: You better come back!
Name: Nathan

SayText1: Most of my items are rare throughout the land.
SayText0: My items are the finest!
SayText2: The value of my items are worth the price.
JoinText: Greetings! Behold my wears, of such you never did see!
LeaveText: Be careful out there!
Name: Maloch

SayText1: Boy this gem is pretty.
SayText0: I don't get much visitors around here :(
SayText2: Can you help me sir? I am in need of a rope!
JoinText: Welcome, how can i be of assistance...
LeaveText: Come back soon!
Name: Fisherman

SayText0: DON'T STEP ON THE DAISIES
JoinText: Don't tread on the flowers! It is difficult for them to grow in such light conditions! I really wish I had some iron rich soil, it might balance out this light situation.
SayText3: Watch your step you overgrown clod-hopper!
Name: Horticulturist

SayText1: Maybe the Horticulterist has something. But I'm so *yawn* tired, I don't want to get up.
SayText0: Something bright an pink and flowery. That's what I need.
SayText4: Maybe the Horticulturist has something. But I'm so *yawn* tired, I don't want to get up.
SayText2: I wish I had a plant or flower or something to brighten up this place.
JoinText: Dirty dank hut. What I really need are some flowers to brighten it up.
LeaveText: Maybe the Horticulterist has something. But I'm so *yawn* tired, I don't want to get up.
Name: Dirt Hermit

SayText1: Are the lice bothering you as much as they are me?
SayText0: Don't forget to wash between your toes!
SayText4: FEED ME!!!
SayText2: I'm starving! Looking at you almost makes me lose my appetite.
JoinText: Oh. It's you again. My other place looks so much better now. I came out here to look for some food because I was hungry. You wouldn't have any food would you?
SayText3: Criminy. It should be illegal to smell like you do. Just don't wave to anyone. Those armpits should be registered as lethal weapons of war. *phew*
Name: Dirt Hermit

SayText1: Oh I *do* hate getting my pretty little feet wet!
SayText0: Please do hurry sir! For I'm going to see my auntie soon!
SayText4: Laa laa laa... la tee da....
SayText2: If only there was something on which to step...
JoinText: Excuse me kind sir, but could you please help me across the stream? There are no stones on which to step, and I'm in a most perilous predicament!
SayText3: *hums to herself*
LeaveText: Thankyou kindly dear sir!
Name: Traveler

SayText1: As if I really have nothing better to do than listen to you ramble on...
SayText0: While you're here, could you help me find my pipe? I just can't remember where I left it...
SayText4: There's just nothing quite like a hot, fresh muffin!
SayText2: Purpcholds! I need more Purpcholds!
JoinText: How in Kankennon's name did you get in here?
SayText3: I wonder what V'Drazzig is doing these days...
LeaveText: Why won't people just leave me alone? Its obvious I want to be left alone when I built my sanctuary deep in a church. God knows what you were doing here.
Name: Trizarhn

SayText1: I have some really good stuff in this chest, but I lost the key!
SayText0: I used to sell picks, but King Dekkar didn't approve.
SayText4: I just love keys. There's something...spiritual about them!
SayText2: My brother Willy recently opened up a locksmith shop.  He's not even a real locksmith!  He just buys exotic keys for his own use!
JoinText: Locked out of the house again, eh?
SayText3: If it's too rusty, don't even bother.
LeaveText: It's an open and shut case!
Name: Locksmith Chuck

SayText1: Oh Banker Taylor? Why he's my brother in law! I'm so happy he's doing well.
SayText0: We offer the finest in banking establishements this side of the Great Desert!
SayText2: A penny saved is a penny earned you know.
JoinText: Hello! How may I help you?
LeaveText: Oh *do* be careful out there!
Name: Banker Wendy

SayText1: Take this here knife. See that blade? DON'T TOUCH IT! AUGH! SOMEONE CALL AN AMBULANCE!!!
SayText0: And this blade here... why it'll cut ye' open like a melon.
SayText4: *whistles a tune to himself*
SayText2: Care to handle the merchandise?
JoinText: Greetings noble warrior! There is great trouble abroad. I can even hear strange noises coming from this shop at night! I think there is a hidden tunnel in here somewhere.
SayText3: No kids or pets allowed... sorry. The cleanup-bill became way too costly. How do you think we painted our floor red? We certainly didn't *intend* for it to turn that color.
LeaveText: Fight evil, and beware of the dark side. It's dangerous outside now!
Name: Boris

JoinText: Welcome to my humble shop of shields
LeaveText: Keep safe!
Name: Lofgan

SayText1: *...green coins in a fountain...*
SayText0: *...oh she'll be comin' 'round the mountain when she comes...*
SayText4: *...it's a wonderful day in the neighborhood... a wonderful day for a neighbor...*
SayText2: *...the ants came marching three by three... hurrah... hurrah...*
JoinText: Greetings traveler! Let me regale you with a jonty tune!
SayText3: *...flinstones... meet the flintstones...*
Name: Bard

SayText1: A noble citizen... yes! A noble citezen of Babylon I was... but no... the yonder ogre stole all that from me! Even if I knew the way I could never return to my wonderful city! No. Never.
SayText0: HAHAHA! They're coming to take me away haha! They're coming to take me away! hehe
SayText4: That evil ogre stole the best years of my life!
SayText2: bloo blah blah bloo blee blahhahahahaha!
JoinText: AAAH! GO AWAY! The owner of yonder castle is a monster! An ogre! He kept me imprisioned... but I escaped! Yes! I escaped! I stay here to warn travelers about it! I wish to God in Heaven that there was a way he would go away!
SayText3: ...bibbidee bobidee boo!
LeaveText: Warn others away! Just DON'T GO INTO THE CASTLE! For the orge within would surely kill you!
Name: Mad Woman

SayText0: You can't kill me! For I am protected by magic. The same magic which curses me is yet my blessing. *sigh*
JoinText: HAHA! Another human to attempt his little "quest". haha. Go ahead and kill me then puny human.
LeaveText: I beat you! Just like everyone! You can't do anything against me. For you are powerless.
Name: Ogre King

JoinText: You entered the castle and lived! Surely he was in a good mood. Here. Take this magic charm, and use it to counter his magic!
LeaveText: Good luck traveler!
Name: Mad Woman

SayText1: I've been transformed! I'm back to my old self! I never dreamed of the day! Please don't kill me. My magical protection is gone. That evil woman who gave you the charm is a witch! She is the one who transformed me 18 years ago! Go! And kill her!
SayText0: I've been transformed! I'm back to my old self! I never dreamed of the day! Please don't kill me. My magical protection is gone. That evil woman who gave you the charm is a witch! She is the one who transformed me 18 years ago! Go! And kill her!
SayText4: I've been transformed! I'm back to my old self! I never dreamed of the day! Please don't kill me. My magical protection is gone. That evil woman who gave you the charm is a witch! She is the one who transformed me 18 years ago! Go! And kill her!
SayText2: I've been transformed! I'm back to my old self! I never dreamed of the day! Please don't kill me. My magical protection is gone. That evil woman who gave you the charm is a witch! She is the one who transformed me 18 years ago! Go! And kill her!
JoinText: I've been transformed! I'm back to my old self! I never dreamed of the day! Please don't kill me. My magical protection is gone. That evil woman who gave you the charm is a witch! She is the one who transformed me 18 years ago! Go! And kill her!
SayText3: I've been transformed! I'm back to my old self! I never dreamed of the day! Please don't kill me. My magical protection is gone. That evil woman who gave you the charm is a witch! She is the one who transformed me 18 years ago! Go! And kill her!
LeaveText: Thankyou good sir! Now that I have been transformed, she is very weak and vulnerable. But she sacficed that for the mere chance of my destruction. Kill her. She will rise again. Kill her then, and again, and don't stop until you have your reward.
Name: Ogre King

SayText1: Just don't kill me! Please!
SayText0: I will never tell you! haha!
SayText4: Enough! Fine! I will tell you! I have hidden it behind the north-east pillar of the castle! Enough!
SayText2: You may kill me... but I will continue to haunt you!
JoinText: AAH! I can still feel his presence! You didn't kill him! He must have turned you! No! I know what you want. I have hidden the ring here. You may kill me a million times. But my magic will bring me back.
Name: Mad Woman

JoinText: Greetings noble warrior! Sorry the place is such a mess.  A man only has two hands!
LeaveText: God speed!
Name: Medeas

SayText1: Please. Buy a helmet. Preferrably a full-face mask. You would do us all a favor.
SayText0: You look just like I feel.
SayText2: Ouch. Get hit in the face with a weedwacker? Should have had one of my helmets.
JoinText: What do you want? A helmet? These are probably too small. You can look anyway.
LeaveText: Good riddance.
Name: Old Skull

SayText1: The Great Pyramid is not very far from here... and I often hear of its many adventures within.
SayText0: Have you heard of the Great Tower Works that the king is thinking of starting? What a grand idea!
JoinText: I am very skilled in the art of mapmaking, if you ever need one.  If you have Ink and Paper, walk infront of me to receive one.
LeaveText: Oh *do* enjoy your stay here! And come here frequently! Up the stairs you will find rooms that we frequently let to passing guilds. To the left is a training room for aspiring adventurers.
Name: Page

SayText1: I have my eye on you.
SayText0: These items can only be used only by the worthy.
SayText2: DON'T TOUCH ANYTHING!!!
JoinText: *Cough* *Cough*Please stay a while.  Oh dear! My wedding is approaching more rapidly than I thought..and still no wedding dress!!!!
SayText3: I need a Gown for my wedding night.
LeaveText: Arrrrrr....now I just need to find a husband...*smirk*
Name: Hilda

SayText1: I hope you find out wine tasty and our food delicious.
SayText0: We sell stuff to warm your bones in this cold place.
SayText2: Better bundle up, I hear a blizzards coming.
JoinText: Hello! Welcome to the Tundra Tavern.
LeaveText: Be careful out there.
Name: Willard

SayText1: Oh, my poor acking back, this cold just isn't good for it.
SayText0: You kill 'em, we buy 'em.
JoinText: Welcome to We Buy Skin, what can I do for you?
LeaveText: Better keep those hides comin', we need to keep warm clothes on everyone.
Name: Grandma Grusome

JoinText: Whazzup Homey? Wanna' buy a one-way ticket to Crendale or a ticket down the mountain? You might want to get back there sometime. I got dem things REAL cheap. For a small fee I'll let you through my portal to my second-cousin Gandalf's house.
LeaveText: Have a nice trip! tee hee hee
Name: Willy da Wizad

SayText1: Why do you continue to bother me, human?
SayText0: I just want to read in peace!
SayText4: I just finished The Da'Vinci Code.. It was exquisite.
SayText2: I shall RIP THE FLESH FROM YOUR BONES.
JoinText: Damn humans, just leave me alone.
SayText3: Say, you don't happen to have a copy of The Count of Monte Cristo, do you?
Name: Varakarad

JoinText: I can make the greatest gourmet meal in all the lands! That's what I do! All day long....it's really getting boring...too bad I have nothing else to do...
Name: Castle Cook

JoinText: You have solved the garden quest. The power of the land shall enchant the simple leather which lies here. Take this equipment and purify the Golgotha lurking deep inside of the Haunted House.
LeaveText: Go in peace.
Name: The Voice

SayText1: A box of Magic Stars is enough for three large bowls of cereal.
SayText0: Muffins are good with honey and butter.
SayText4: Ruffles have ridges! (TM)
SayText2: If you want the best, try Kank's Cake!
JoinText: Welcome to the most famous bakery in the land! You know what this place could use? FLOWERS! I hear some big shot fella' of the Elves loves cake.  Eh?
SayText3: Kank's Donuts are made with only the finest of ingredients.
LeaveText: Please enjoy your delicious foodstuffs!
Name: Chef Brockett

SayText1: For every one you kill, another takes it's place!
SayText0: The G'Loritches entered the tower through a rift gate.
SayText4: Someday, maybe V'Drazzig will return to his tower...
SayText2: A horde of those creatures ran V'Drazzig out of his own tower.
JoinText: How did you ever make it past those beasts?
SayText3: I'll gladly reward you for each G'Loritch you slay.
LeaveText: Good luck fighting those foul denizens!
Name: Tower Hermit

SayText1: What?! Another raid?
SayText0: There has to be some way of getting rid of the savages...
SayText4: Oh! I'd give anything for the head of the leader of the savages!
SayText2: Oh! I'd give anything for the head of the leader of the savages!
JoinText: What are you doing here?
SayText3: Oh! I'd give anything for the head of the leader of the savages!
LeaveText: Good riddance! So many distractions...
Name: Amazon Chief

SayText1: I sure hate those damned G'Loritches!
SayText0: My portals will take you to wherever you wish to go.
SayText4: I sure do miss my comfy tower...
SayText2: Learn from my mistakes--Never open portals into the outer realms!
JoinText: You have journeyed far to find me, adventurer!
SayText3: They just can't be endless. Keep killing those things, they should eventually all die.
LeaveText: Say hello to Trizarhn for me...
Name: Tower Keeper

JoinText: ~Trade your Viking Sword for a Wand of Icarus here~
Name: Un Voz Uno

JoinText: ~Trade King's Wrappings for a Skullblade here~
Name: Un Voz Dos

SayText1: To the east is an All Players Arena! Enjoy the stay and happy fighting!
JoinText: Welcome to the arena! You can bank by typing /bank, and you may also repair your items here!
LeaveText: Good luck in your battle! Let the games begin!
Name: Referee Garlic

SayText1: Now where did I put that elixir?
SayText0: The book of shadows holds the key.
SayText2: The book of shadows holds the key.
JoinText: Welcome my friend.
SayText3: The book of shadows holds the key.
LeaveText: Please be careful out there..
Name: Bremen

SayText1: My father once told me a tale about a great beast with fur as soft as silk...

JoinText: This map's name is in red. Which means this whole map is PK and you can get killed. Many guild halls, houses, and quests have red maps in them. So beware of the PKers in this game, they will often try to lure new comers in there and kill them!

JoinText: Good job completing this quest adventurer! It must've been tough, but the prize is valued by every warrior of this land!
LeaveText: I best heed you to be careful East of Crendale... Many have said that the Norax clan are taking shelter deep under the forest. The Norax clan, especially their leader.... Are dangerous

JoinText: Oh... You were able to pierce through Norax clan to achieve their treasure? You have potential...
LeaveText: Let me reward you with some advice for being a brave and distinguished warrior... Lately, the Horticulturist has been stealing the treasures that the Norax has raided and hid them deep into garden south from Crystal Lake.

SayText1: I will buy with you, sell with you, talk with you, walk with you, and so following; but I will not eat with you, drink with you, nor pray with you.
SayText0: My god is here, somewhere, yet I have not seen him in many long nights.
SayText2: I am a Dragonian. Hath not a Dragonian eyes? Hath not a Dragonian hands, organs, dimensions, senses, affections, passions?
JoinText: This land is not forgiving, friend, and if you fail to watch your back, you shall fall.
SayText3: That fool Antonio owes me money.

SayText0: CHAAAANNGE!!

JoinText: Welcome to the Games House. Buy your Game Tokens here to play the games.
Name: Madhatter

JoinText: Welcome, I have all the goods you desire! I can also store your equipment for you!
Name: Merchant Banker

JoinText: Welcome to my skills market adventurer. I deal in natural resources, and people travel near and far for my wares.
Name: Trader Joe

SayText1: Shields are out this season.
SayText0: I used to sell shields, but they're not glamourous enough for me.
SayText2: This would look amazing on you!
JoinText: Welcome to my Fashion Emporium. We have all the current trends from around the world and for only 10k you can have your pick of them all!
Name: Lofgan

JoinText: Would you like to sample my Dwarven Brew? One sip shall restore all of your Energy, and all for only 3k gold.
Name: Dragonian Miner

JoinText: Welcome to the Kingdom Smith, first smith to the Dekkars of Dragonia.  Allow me to mend your worn equipment... for a price of course.
Name: Jacob

JoinText: Welcome to Babylon Cafe, can I get you anything?
LeaveText: See you around, tell your friends.
Name: Jimmy

JoinText: Greetings child, enter. We monks are simple folk dedicated to learning. However to support our monestry we sell our own wine. Its pretty good.
Name: Monk

JoinText: This is my Skills Market, adventurer. Type /market to have a look around.
Name: Bazar

SayText1: Don't mind Bruno, he gets jumpy at times.
SayText0: Wooden walls unsafe? Never.
JoinText: Welcome to the Sanctuary Bank, the safest place to keep your most prized possessions!
Name: Banker Selma

JoinText: Greetings, type /craft if you wish to see an example of my meddlings.
Name: Sanctuary Wench

JoinText: Welcome to Crendale.  I am able to change your class for 50,000 gold.  Just say knight, cleric, mage, or rogue.
LeaveText: Good luck on your travels!
Name: Lord Bob

JoinText: Come in child! If it is potions you seek then you have come to the right place.
LeaveText: Be careful with those mind.
Name: Granny Gertrude

SayText1: I'm sorry for deceiving you, but you too are already benefitting from the Duck equipment.  We are brothers in this fight now.
SayText0: We only want to use the powers of the Ducks to help protect our own lands.
SayText2: The ducks are fierce and inside Ancient Island lives a terrible power that nobody has been able to successfully fight.
JoinText: Yes, it is I, the Easter Master.  I knew when I sent in the bunnies that this would create war between the ducks and the humans.  We only want to use their power to help protect our lands.  I'm sorry I hid my true purpose.
LeaveText: Come back anytime you want to exchange tokens for the genuine article!
Name: Easter Master

SayText1: There is a maximum of five challengers that may enter.
SayText0: Before you even think about entering the Fire Lord's lair, you had better select only your finest and best equipped warriors.
SayText4: Maybe your party has what it takes to beat Lavos, but very few parties return the same. The greed, arrogance, and pride that unfolds can tear strong groups apart.
SayText2: I'll try to channel through the Fire Shield to keep your group from losing items and experience from within his fire chamber. Good luck!
JoinText: Well, what do we have here? Do you honestly think you have what it takes to defeat Lavos? If you enter, I will try my best to protect you from losing your items and experience.
SayText3: Admittingly, during my own raid, our warriors failed to realize that sheer might was not enough to win.
Name: Barbarian Chief

JoinText: Welcome to the lounge room. Please, make yourselves at home! Check out my exclusive prices! I can also change your class for only 35,000 gold.
Name: Fort Merchant
